preconditions.description: The number of rows in the field is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of columns in the field is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The field size is at least 2x2, ensuring the king can travel through the whole country.

postconditions.description: The output should either be 0 if no teleporters are needed, or k + 2 lines if teleporters are used, where k is the number of teleporters.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1, x2 <= n and 1 <= y1, y2 <= m for each teleporter)
postconditions.description: The coordinates of each teleporter installation are within the bounds of the field.

postconditions.expression: all(line in output for line in visited_squares) and (1, 1) appears exactly twice at the start and end of visited_squares
postconditions.description: The output includes the complete journey path, starting and ending at (1, 1), visiting each square exactly once except the capital which is visited twice.

invariants.description: The field size is at least 2x2, ensuring the king can travel through the whole country.
